snippet.title: Key Terms: The Skeptic's Toolkit

Part of the playlist Computational Skepticism, Exam Prep: one film per chapter of INFO 7375, Computational Skepticism for AI. 6:24 Artifact versus world, and the slice
7:06 The solve-verify asymmetry
7:50 Capacities one, two and four
8:50 Capacities three and five, and no tool yet
9:59 Fluency, teams and the locked prediction
11:23 Look-alike pairs
12:26 Say it exactly
